confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Tuscan town pricing in peak summer; restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since Lucca has a small hostel supply and July demand is high. Drink anchors use the typical tourist-centre premium over Pisa and Siena. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au pages, not a verified page read, so the server should confirm it against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on nearby Tuscan towns with similar tourist demand, chiefly Pisa and Siena, adjusted for Lucca's walled-centre tourist premium in July. Accommodation includes the local tourist tax, as mandatory fees are part of the definition.
